arxiv-2408-01603.title: FIVB ranking: Misstep in the right direction
arxiv-2408-01603.creator: Salma Tenni, Daniel Gomes de Pinho Zanco, Leszek Szczecinski
arxiv-2408-01603.description: Abstract This work presents and evaluates the ranking algorithm that has been used by Fédération Internationale de Volleyball (FIVB) since 2020. The prominent feature of the FIVB ranking is the use of the probabilistic model, which explicitly calculates the probabilities of the future matches results using the estimated teams’ strengths.

arxiv-2503-19028.description: Abstract In these proceedings, we summarize our recent findings on a minimal renormalizable S ​ O ​ ( 10 ) SO(10) grand unified theory. pmc-11434888.title: Group B Streptococcus Infections in Non-Pregnant Adults, Italy, 2015–2019
pmc-11434888.creator: Monica Imperi, Giovanni Gherardi, Giovanna Alfarone, Roberta Creti, Anders Sjöstedt, Barbara Spellerberg
pmc-11434888.description: Group B Streptococcus (GBS, Streptococcus agalactiae) is a pathogen of increasing importance in adults. Severe and invasive cases in non-pregnant adults were collected during the period 2015–2019 by voluntary-based surveillance. In total, 108 GBS strains were phenotypically and genotypically characterized for the serotype, antimicrobial resistance, pili, surface protein genes, and the hyper-virulent adhesin hvgA.

pmc-11467729.title: G protein coupled receptor in apoptosis and apoptotic cell clearance
pmc-11467729.creator: Xinyan Li, Chao Li, Yang Kang, Rui Zhang, Peiyao Li, Qian Zheng, Hui Wang, Hui Xiao, Lei Yuan
pmc-11467729.description: Apoptosis is a genetically programmed form of cell death that is substantially conserved across the evolutionary tree. Apoptotic cell elimination includes recognition, phagocytosis, and degradation. Failure to clear apoptotic cells can ultimately cause a series of human diseases, such as systemic lupus erythematosus, Alzheimer's disease, atherosclerosis, and cancer.

pmc-12734855.title: Adaptive Fuzzy Fixed-Time Trajectory Tracking Control for a Piezoelectric-Driven Microinjector
pmc-12734855.creator: Rungeng Zhang, Zehao Wu, Weijian Zhang, Qingsong Xu
pmc-12734855.description: This paper proposes an adaptive fuzzy fixed-time control (AF-FxT-C) scheme for a piezoelectric-driven microinjector. The inherent hysteresis of the piezoelectric actuator is treated as an unknown nonlinearity. A fuzzy logic system is employed to approximate this hysteresis, along with other lumped disturbances, while an adaptive law is designed to improve approximation accuracy.

pmc-13032750.title: The effects of intravenous immunoglobulin on intestinal inflammation: a systematic review of animal and clinical studies
pmc-13032750.creator: Tiancheng Chu, Xin Yuan, Tong Wang, Wei Zhang, Xiaochen Yan, Changqing Li, Peng Jiang, Shengliang Ye, Li Ma, Pan Sun, Xi Du, Ping Fu, Zongkui Wang
pmc-13032750.description: BackgroundIntestinal inflammation encompasses a range of conditions, including inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), radiation-induced enteritis, and chemotherapy- or toxin-induced epithelial injury. Although intravenous immunoglobulin (IVIg) is widely used in autoimmune and inflammatory disorders, its role in these forms of intestinal injury has not been systematically evaluated.

pmc-13380628.title: Long-term outcomes following primary resection of intraosseous meningiomas with concurrent cranioplasty: a population-based Swedish multicentre study
pmc-13380628.creator: Robert F Nilsson, Alba Corell, Emilia Muncan, Peter Lindvall, Rickard L Sjöberg, Richard Ågren, Bjartur Sæmundsson, Alexander Fletcher-Sandersjöö, Ulrik Birgersson, Jimmy Sundblom, Mats Ryttlefors, Göran Hesselager, David Fröjd Revesz, Teodor Svedung Wettervik, Klas Holmgren
pmc-13380628.description: BackgroundStudies on intraosseous meningiomas requiring cranioplasty have been scarce, and surgical outcomes thus remain poorly characterized. Using a population-based, multicentre cohort of patients who had undergone resection of intraosseous meningioma with concurrent cranioplasty, we aimed to establish long-term outcomes, as well as rates and predictors of complications and tumour recurrence.
